verdict.rationale: Automatic typed client code generation is a fair question for a backend platform like Firebase, so the axis applies, but no evidence in the pack documents generating TypeScript types or typed SDKs from a schema. The closest item is Gemini in Firebase generating schemas, queries, and mutations from natural language, which is AI-assisted authoring and not automatic typed client generation from a schema. Firebase SQL Connect is mentioned only as an MCP data target, with no codegen evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate typed client code (e.g. TypeScript types) from my schema automatically
